messages:
Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — RC build for v1.5 is scheduled to be tagged and pushed at 18:00 PT. Need final confirmation on binaries + changelog. Please ack if you own any backports/branch bumps. If you plan a late merge, drop the PR number, risk level (low/med/high), and the exact git commands you'll run. Keep this thread for coordination only.

Maria Gonzalez: Ack. I'm on docs and the release notes. I'll add any missing changelog entries under a changelog draft PR. Will ping when done. :memo:

Priya Nair: Heads up — seeing a flaky failure in staging: integration-test-slo. Investigating now; if we don't have a fix in ~30m we should ship RC and follow up with a post-rc patch.

Samir Patel: I have one backport for the release branch: PR #5187 (grpc timeout edge-case). CI passed locally. Risk: low. Will rebase and add a release-notes line if you want it in.

Jules (Oncall): Watchdog note — no infra-facing changes after 17:30 PT unless it's emergency. Also double-check the signing key rotation: make sure build agent has the current key.

CI Bot: Build started: 1.5-rc-20240311 (job 88421). Artifacts: s3://redwood-releases/1.5/1.5-rc-20240311.tar.gz.

Alex Chen: @Priya if the test is still failing at 17:45 PT, mark it post-rc. @Samir can you rebase and add this line to changelog: "fix: grpc timeout backport (#5187)"? Also, if anyone is doing a late-merge, include exact cherry-pick command so ops can audit.

Maria Gonzalez: Opening changelog PR now. One question: do we include the experimental quantized runtime notes in the headline? It's borderline.

Priya Nair: Put the quantized runtime note under Known issues and not in the top-level highlights. We don't want customers expecting GA.

Samir Patel: Cherry-pick command I'll use:
```
git checkout release/1.5 && git pull origin release/1.5
git cherry-pick -x 6a7b8c9
git push origin release/1.5
```
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5187 (labelled backport/release-1.5).

Alex Chen: Late-merge guidance for this RC: trivial bug fixes that only touch a single package and have green CI are OK. Anything that touches infra, build, or new deps = no-go without exception. To request an exception, post the PR link here, mark risktag:high/med/low, and @eng-releases will triage. Label the PR with `release/1.5/late-merge`.

Priya Nair: I'm going to skip the flaky integration test for the RC if I can't get a fix in 30m. Filing INF-334 to track the follow-up.

Release Bot: Reminder — changelog & docs freeze cutoff is 17:30 PT. Final tag will be at 18:00 PT unless we see blockers.

Maria Gonzalez: Changelog PR opened: #5198. @security @legal please confirm there are no embargoed items or third-party license concerns.

Security: Quick scan complete — no flagged licenses or embargoed content. Cleared for release.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone. If there are no objections by 17:55 PT we'll tag, push the RC binary, and notify infra to start signing. :rocket:
